name: Connects — Virtual Token Economy

description: Two provider membership tiers: Basic (Free, current plan) providing essential features, and Freelancer Plus ($19.99/month) offering proposal insights, 0% service fee on Direct Contracts, profile visibility during breaks, and ad product discounts; billing cycle shown as monthly.
